author: SOC Team

# Phishing Email Response Playbook

## Overview
This runbook covers the triage and response workflow for suspected phishing emails and related alerts.

**MITRE ATT&CK:** [T1566 - Phishing](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/)

---

## Triggers
- Email security gateway high-confidence phishing verdict
- User-reported suspicious email (`phish@company.com` mailbox)
- Credential harvesting alert from identity provider
- Alert severity: **High** or **Critical**

---

## Step 1 — Initial Triage (T1 Analyst)

- [ ] Set Status → `in_progress`, assign to self
- [ ] Review sender domain against known-bad list
- [ ] Check if email contains URLs or attachments
- [ ] Query delivery count:
  ```
  index=email_logs subject="<subject>" | stats count by recipient
  ```
- [ ] Determine scope: **single user** vs **mass delivery**

> **Tip:** If 10+ recipients received the same email → escalate to T2 immediately.

---

## Step 2 — Link / Attachment Analysis (T1/T2)

### URLs
- [ ] Extract all URLs from email body
- [ ] Run through VirusTotal / URLScan.io
- [ ] Check proxy/web gateway logs for user clicks:
  ```
  index=proxy url=<url> | stats count by src_ip, user
  ```

### Attachments
- [ ] Hash the attachment (SHA256)
- [ ] Submit to sandbox (Joe Sandbox / Any.Run)
- [ ] Check EDR for execution on endpoints

---

## Step 3 — User & Credential Impact Assessment

- [ ] Did any user click the link?
- [ ] Did any user enter credentials?
- [ ] Check IdP logs for login anomalies within 30 min of click time:
  ```
  index=okta eventType=user.session.start earliest=-1h latest=+30m@click_time
  ```
- [ ] Check for MFA bypass attempts or new device enrollment

---

## Step 4 — Containment

| Action | Tool | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| Block sender domain | Email Gateway | Add to blocklist |
| Recall email | M365 / Exchange | Remove from all mailboxes |
| Block URLs | Proxy / Firewall | All redirect chains |
| Reset credentials | Active Directory | If credentials entered |
| Revoke sessions | Okta / Azure AD | Force re-auth |
| Isolate endpoint | EDR (CrowdStrike) | If malware executed |

---

## Step 5 — Escalation Criteria

Escalate to **T2** if:
- Any user clicked the link
- Attachment was delivered and opened

Escalate to **T3** if:
- Credentials were entered and MFA bypassed
- Endpoint compromise confirmed
- C2 beaconing detected post-click

---

## Step 6 — Close / Document

- [ ] Update ticket status in triage queue
- [ ] Note verdict: FP / TP / Benign
- [ ] Add sender domain to suppression if FP (with justification)
- [ ] Submit IOCs to threat intel platform

---

## References
- [MITRE T1566](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/)
- [CISA Phishing Guidance](https://www.cisa.gov/phishing)
